# Labels

Labels recommended for the repository. Create them by hand in **Issues → Labels**, using the name and colour
below. The issue templates already use `bug`, `enhancement`, `trainer-support` and `translation`.

| Label | Colour | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `good first issue` | `#7057ff` | Small, well-described task for a first contribution |
| `trainer-support` | `#0e8a16` | Compatibility reports and driver work for smart trainers |
| `translation` | `#1d76db` | Translations, wording and glossary |
| `game` | `#d93f0b` | In-app games (`js/games/`) |
| `android` | `#3ddc84` | Android app (Capacitor project, native plugins) |
| `web` | `#0052cc` | Web app and PWA |
| `bug` | `#d73a4a` | Something does not work as expected |
| `enhancement` | `#a2eeef` | New feature or improvement |
